value.rationale: This is the integral homotopy classification for the canonical Fano-plane incidence graph at the first higher-independence parameter, a natural nonchordal test beyond tree and block classifications. It establishes a nontrivial wedge of thirteen 5-spheres for a six-dimensional nonpure complex and provides a fully reproducible Morse certificate.
